19:46 Local Time, 18:46 GMT, 00:16 IST: England go 1-0 up. Not an easy pitch and surprisingly this one aided spin when that is not the norm here. Will Jacks with superb control of line and length finishes with his maiden fifer. Kumar Sangakkara on air called Sri Lanka's batting "Timid" while Mark Butcher reckoned it was "Meek". The openers started off decently but once Kamindu went, the innings got stuck. The middle-overs, England were allowed to bowl dot after dot and as a result the pressure shot up. Wickets came due to that and some poor shot selection too cost Sri Lanka - both Asalanka and Kusal Mendis falling to sweeps to Jacks. Wellalage at the end when the game was almost done, played some beautiful shots to delay the inevitable. England used the pitch by bowling a hard length and then Jacks was outstanding. Jacks 2/2: [Were you aware Sri Lanka were slow with their over-rate?] I'd like to say so, but personally no. I think we were more worried about batting the 50 overs. Obviously we lost quite a few wickets, and I think that just worked in my favour. [Does that change how you approach your bowling?] I think obviously having batted on it and knowing what it was like, I knew I was going to play a decent role, and then depending on what time you bowl, it doesn't really bother me now. I think Harry likes us to be as flexible as possible, and that's why I think we're achieving some good things. So no matter the time, you've just got to do your best. [How satisfying was that delivery for your five-for?] Yeah, they were taking the mickey out of me for lobbing that one up to Asitha Fernando, so I thought I'd have to bowl a good one for the fifth one.

Harry Brook | England captain 1/2: [How pleased are you with that performance today?] It wasn't the easiest of surfaces, but I said the other day that we want to be a team that can adapt to conditions as well as possible and manufacture wins when the conditions aren't quite in our favour, and I thought we did that very well today. [What did you think of 265 at halfway?] After about 20 overs, we said 280 would be a decent score, and we managed to scrap away to get 260 (265), so we were pretty happy with it in the end, and we knew exactly what we were going to try to do with the ball before we went out there and delivered that beautifully.

Brook 2/2: [On Will Jacks] Outstanding player, has been for many years now. He's been a constant performer in franchise cricket, and then the way that he's come in and played this role with us in the middle-order and taking a heavy part of the bowling as well, he's been an awesome player to have in the side. [What does Jamie Overton add in the middle-overs?] He's been another outstanding player for us in both T20s and ODIs. But I think the clarity we had before going out there into the field was outstanding. The communication was very good. We knew we just had to keep the stumps in play as much as possible. [How do you feel Rehan Ahmed performed today?] I think he went well, to be honest. He did everything that we asked him to do. He kept the stumps in play as much as he could and gave the ball a bit of a rag, so it was nice to see that he bowled well and unfortunately he just got a little bit of tap at the end.
